title: What time is F1's 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix? Full weekend schedule
paragraphs: Presented by Apple TV The Formula 1® Grande Prêmio de São Paulo 2026 is the first race after Kimi Antonelli's coronation - but while the drivers' title is already decided, there are high stakes in the constructors' championship and in the race win battle at a track as prestigious as this.
